description: Address all 9 issues found by semantic reviewer: fork code execution guard, canary error rate validation, performance RESULT_FILE fix, security-patterns.yml usage, uptime cancel-in-progress, license audit deduplication, auto-fix git add scope, canary environment guard, release checkout ambiguity.
steps: Fix agent-auto-fix.yml: add fork PR guard, use --ignore-scripts --no-frozen-lockfile, scope git add to apps/backend/ apps/edge/ apps/frontend/
Fix agent-canary-deploy.yml: add error_rate validation guard step, add environment: production
Fix agent-performance-regression.yml: use find command directly in parse step instead of broken env var
Fix agent-security-scan.yml: rewrite grep scan to read from security-patterns.yml via Python
Fix agent-uptime-monitor.yml: change cancel-in-progress to false
Fix agent-license-audit.yml: search for existing open compliance issues before creating new one
Fix agent-release.yml: add ref: main conditional on checkout for PR label trigger
acceptance_criteria: agent-auto-fix.yml skips fork PRs and uses --ignore-scripts
agent-canary-deploy.yml validates error_rate before promote/rollback decisions
agent-performance-regression.yml correctly locates Lighthouse result files
agent-license-audit.yml updates existing issues instead of creating duplicates
agent-release.yml uses explicit ref for checkout based on event type
All workflow files remain valid YAML
verification: Run: python3 -c "import yaml; [yaml.safe_load(open(f)) for f in __import__('glob').glob('.github/workflows/agent-*.yml')]" to validate YAML
Verify fork guard in auto-fix with grep
Verify error_rate validation in canary with grep
Verify find usage in performance with grep
findings: All 9 issues from the semantic review addressed. YAML validation passes for all modified workflow files. Fork guard added to auto-fix, error_rate validation and environment protection added to canary, RESULT_FILE correctly passed via shell export instead of broken step output, security scan now dynamically reads patterns from YAML, uptime monitor no longer cancels overlapping runs, license audit deduplicates issues, release workflow uses explicit ref for PR-triggered runs.
